observations: Three photos show a black electronic keyboard with white and black keys, placed on an orange plastic chair.
The keyboard has a central control panel with a small LCD screen, buttons, and a dial.
The keys appear to be standard piano-style, with 61 keys visible in the photos.
The keyboard has a purple and teal color scheme on the control panel.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is visible in white letters on the top and front of the keyboard in all photos.
The keyboard is not powered on; no sound is heard in the photos.
The background shows a concrete wall and floor, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
Watermark 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' is visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The brand 'YAMAHA' is clearly visible on the top and front of the keyboard in all photos.
No sound is heard in the photos, and no video shows the keys being pressed. The keyboard is not powered on, so functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.
No adapter is visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not be functional (keys/buttons not working, no sound).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, with keys being pressed and sound produced.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be damaged or have internal faults not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the keys being pressed and the LCD screen responding, along with a test of the power button and volume controls.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing accessories (e.g., power adapter, stand, or manuals).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, with keys being pressed and sound produced.
Close-up video of the LCD screen and buttons responding to input.
Photo of all included accessories (power adapter, stand, manuals, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
